korean_title: 2026학년도 2학기 대학원 논문연구 과목수강 확인서 제출 안내(필수)

original.text: - 제출대상: 대학원 논문연구(430.960) 수강신청한 모든 대학원생 제출 필수(미제출 시 성적은 U로 부여됩니다)
- 제출방법: 아래 1번. 2번. 모두 하셔야 신청 완료됩니다.
2) 첨부파일 확인서 작성(지도교수 날인 포함)하여 319호 담당자 앞 제출
- 첨부파일 다운로드 > 연구내용, 논문제목, 참고문헌(3개 이상) 포함하여 1페이지 이내 작성 필요
- 담당교수는 본인이 수강신청한 논문연구 과목의 교수님 이름을 적으면 됩니다.
사유가 있어 지도교수님 이외의 교수님께 신청한 학생은 서류 상단에 지도교수명과 신청교수님명을 각각 적고, 서류 하단에 담당(신청)교수님께 서명을 받으면 됩니다.
- 석박통합과정 학생 중 논문연구 과목을 한 학기 2개 강좌 중복수강 할 경우, 반드시 사전에 교수님께 허락을 받아야 하며, 두 분 교수님께 각각 확인서를 받아 제출해야 합니다.

english: - Who must submit: Submission is mandatory for all graduate students registered for Graduate Thesis Research (대학원 논문연구, 430.960) (if you do not submit, you will receive a grade of U (Unsatisfactory))
- How to submit: You must complete both steps 1 and 2 below for your application to be complete.
1) First, fill out the Google Form: https://forms.gle/o1sWaLY5wiaKxsKz7
2) Fill out the confirmation form in the attached file (including your advisor's 날인 (seal or signature)) and submit it to the staff member in charge in Room 319
- Download the attached file > Write no more than 1 page, including your research content, thesis title, and references (3 or more)
- For the professor in charge (담당교수), write the name of the professor of the Thesis Research course you registered for.
- Usually, students register for the course under their advisor, so the professor in charge = the advisor; however,

students who, for a specific reason, registered under a professor other than their advisor should write both the advisor's name and the name of the professor they registered under at the top of the form, and get the signature of the professor in charge (the professor they registered under) at the bottom of the form.

- Students in the integrated Master's-Ph.D. program (석박통합과정) who take 2 sections of the Thesis Research course in the same semester must get permission from the professors in advance, and must get a separate confirmation form from each of the two professors and submit both.

(Note)
- Attached file: Graduate Thesis Research Course Registration Confirmation Form (대학원 논문연구 과목수강 확인서)
- The above is a department internal regulation (학부내규), in effect since the 1st semester of 2016.
- Inquiries: Department Administrative Office (Building 301, Room 319) / 박한수 (Park Han-su) / hansoopark@snu.ac.kr
